content.name: Equipment Mod Sync
content.description:
On a large ship, putting the same equipment mod on every turret group means opening each slot and pressing Install, or Reroll, twenty or thirty times. This mod adds a checkbox to the Modify screen: tick it, install or reroll the mod on one slot, and every other compatible slot in that category gets the same treatment.
[h2]What it does[/h2] [list] [*][b]Apply to all.[/b] Weapons, turrets and shields get a checkbox above their slots. With it ticked, the slot you click is done first, exactly as vanilla does it, and every other slot of the category follows, each through vanilla's own install path and paid for as if clicked by hand. [*][b]Install and Reroll.[/b] Install fills every slot, empty ones included. Reroll only touches slots that already hold a mod. [*][b]Bonus effects are matched.[/b] A mod picks its bonus effects at random from a pool, so two slots can end up with different ones. After the batch, every slot whose bonus effects differ from the clicked slot's is rerolled again until they match. These extra rerolls are free: no credits, and the materials they use are put back. [*][b]It stops cleanly.[/b] Slots that cannot take the mod are skipped, and the batch stops at the first slot you cannot pay for, in materials or credits. The slots done by then stay done. [/list] A line under the checkbox shows what the last batch did and cost.
[h2]Values are still random[/h2] The game rolls a mod's values when it is installed and offers no way to set them, so each slot gets its own roll: matching makes the kind of bonus effects identical, not their size. For identical, maximum values on every slot, use it together with any mod that sets the equipment mod ranges to their maximum, such as Max Equipment Mods. The two do not touch each other.
[h2]Settings[/h2] [list] [*][b]Checkbox ticked on open[/b] - off by default. Whether the checkbox starts ticked when the Modify screen opens. [*][b]Replace a different mod[/b] - on by default. What applying to all does with a slot that already holds a different mod: replace it, the same as dismantling it by hand first, or leave it alone. [*][b]Match bonus effects[/b] - on by default. [*][b]Free rerolls per slot[/b] - 10 to 500, default 100. How many free rerolls a slot gets to match before it is left as it is. [*][b]Debug logging[/b] - off by default. Writes every batch, with the credits and materials each phase used, to the debug log. [/list]
[h2]Where to change them[/h2] With SirNukes Mod Support APIs installed: [b]Options - Extension Options - Equipment Mod Sync[/b]. Without it the defaults apply.
[h2]Dependencies[/h2] [list] [*][b]X4: Foundations 9.00[/b] - required. [*][b]SirNukes Mod Support APIs[/b] - optional, and only for the settings. Everything works without it. [*]No DLC required. [/list]
[h2]Notes[/h2] Works on an existing savegame, and with Protected UI Mode on. It is a UI mod that replaces no game file: it wraps four functions of the ship configuration menu, so it also works on top of kuertee's UI Extensions. Removing it leaves every installed mod as it is.
Source and full documentation: https://github.com/drjele/x4-equipment-mod-sync

text.name: Equipment Mod Sync
text.description: Adds a checkbox to the ship Modify screen: installing or rerolling an equipment mod on one turret, weapon or shield slot does the same on every compatible slot of the category, paid for as if clicked by hand, and rerolls the others for free until their bonus effects match. Works on an existing savegame.
